## Empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of clear eyesight

As your partner, we are dedicated to helping you achieve the practice you envision – every step of
the way. Whether it is a patient who needs your care or a customer who looks to you for advice, we
are here to help you shape the best customer experience. You can also count on us to help you run
and expand your business. With education and insights for you and your team. And by providing you
with support, technology and systems to optimize your practice. We consider our partnership
successful when you have everything you need: to empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of
clear eyesight.

[ Your business partner ][111]
[Close-up image of a HOYA lens]

## Our Vision Products

[ Vision products ][112]
Empower your patients to pursue their life’s vision, with solutions for every visual need.
[HOYA graphic grey lines]

#### Progressive lenses

Individualized and tailored to your patients’ unique lifestyles.

[See progressive lenses][113]

#### Sun solutions

Enhanced visual performance, comfort and protection in the most fashionable styles.

[See sun solutions][114]

#### Single vision lenses

Pixel-perfect precision and outstanding visual performance.

[See single vision lenses][115]
[HOYA graphic blue lines]

#### Special situation lenses

For the full spectrum of visual requirements: lenses for children, athletes and driving.

[See special situation lenses][116]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## “Together, we can tackle myopia in children”

Myopia progression can be controlled, not only corrected. Most spectacle lenses simply help the
child see clearly. While they correct vision, they don't help manage how myopia progresses over time
- that's why HOYA created MiYOSMART. At HOYA Vision Care, we are committed to helping children see
clearly and live fuller, more confident lives.

[ Discover our myopia management solutions ][117]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## Visionary Knowledge

[ Explore visionary knowledge ][118]
As an eye care professional, you invest years of education to develop and refine your expertise. It
is our mission to support and empower you in your journey. We will help you see what lies ahead: for
your staff, patients and customers. Ultimately, this vision is what makes your practice thrive.

## For the Visionaries

[Older man with HOYA lenses wearing beige shirt]

## It is our mission to empower and support our visionaries.

We all have a vision of how we want our future to be, of what we want to experience or achieve in
life, and the impact we want to make. But whatever your vision is, clear eyesight helps to bring it
to life.

We have been a partner to you, eye care professionals, for over 80 years and see the world through
your eyes. You spend years honing your craft through education, gradually developing and refining
your knowledge. And finally, you are recognized for demonstrating that expertise.

 

## You change how thousands of people see the world every day and to us, you are visionaries.

[ About HOYA Vision Care ][110]
[Older man with HOYA lenses wearing beige shirt]
[video thumbnail]

## Your business partner

Dedicated to helping you achieve the practice you envision.
[Close-up image of a HOYA lens]

## Empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of clear eyesight

As your partner, we are dedicated to helping you achieve the practice you envision – every step of
the way. Whether it is a patient who needs your care or a customer who looks to you for advice, we
are here to help you shape the best customer experience. You can also count on us to help you run
and expand your business. With education and insights for you and your team. And by providing you
with support, technology and systems to optimize your practice. We consider our partnership
successful when you have everything you need: to empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of
clear eyesight.

[ Your business partner ][111]
[Close-up image of a HOYA lens]

## Our Vision Products

[ Vision products ][112]
Empower your patients to pursue their life’s vision, with solutions for every visual need.
[HOYA graphic grey lines]

#### Progressive lenses

Individualized and tailored to your patients’ unique lifestyles.

[See progressive lenses][113]

#### Sun solutions

Enhanced visual performance, comfort and protection in the most fashionable styles.

[See sun solutions][114]

#### Single vision lenses

Pixel-perfect precision and outstanding visual performance.

[See single vision lenses][115]
[HOYA graphic blue lines]

#### Special situation lenses

For the full spectrum of visual requirements: lenses for children, athletes and driving.

[See special situation lenses][116]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## “Together, we can tackle myopia in children”

Myopia progression can be controlled, not only corrected. Most spectacle lenses simply help the
child see clearly. While they correct vision, they don't help manage how myopia progresses over time
- that's why HOYA created MiYOSMART. At HOYA Vision Care, we are committed to helping children see
clearly and live fuller, more confident lives.

[ Discover our myopia management solutions ][117]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

As an eye care professional, you invest years of education to develop and refine your expertise. It
is our mission to support and empower you in your journey. We will help you see what lies ahead: for
your staff, patients and customers. Ultimately, this vision is what makes your practice thrive.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## FAQ

1. What kind of content does Business Strategy Hub offer?

Business Strategy Hub provides detailed business strategies, SWOT analyses, marketing case studies,
and brand insights from well-known global companies. It’s designed to help students, marketers,
entrepreneurs, and business enthusiasts understand how companies grow and compete in the market.

2. Who creates the content for the site?

A dedicated team of writers and business researchers prepares all content. They ensure every article
is based on real-world facts, updated information, and reliable sources to maintain accuracy and
relevance.

3. Can I use this content for school or university projects?

Yes, the website is useful in academic work. You can refer to the content for assignments,
presentations, or case studies. Just remember to cite the website as your source when using the
information.

4. Does Business Strategy Hub only feature big companies?

While most content focuses on global brands, the site also covers emerging companies and
lesser-known businesses that have interesting strategies or market positions.

5. How often is the content updated?

The Business Strategy Hub team regularly reviews and updates its content to keep up with industry
changes and company developments, ensuring users always get current and reliable business insights.

## FAQ

1. What kind of content does Business Strategy Hub offer?

Business Strategy Hub provides detailed business strategies, SWOT analyses, marketing case studies,
and brand insights from well-known global companies. It’s designed to help students, marketers,
entrepreneurs, and business enthusiasts understand how companies grow and compete in the market.

2. Who creates the content for the site?

A dedicated team of writers and business researchers prepares all content. They ensure every article
is based on real-world facts, updated information, and reliable sources to maintain accuracy and
relevance.

3. Can I use this content for school or university projects?

Yes, the website is useful in academic work. You can refer to the content for assignments,
presentations, or case studies. Just remember to cite the website as your source when using the
information.

4. Does Business Strategy Hub only feature big companies?

While most content focuses on global brands, the site also covers emerging companies and
lesser-known businesses that have interesting strategies or market positions.

5. How often is the content updated?

The Business Strategy Hub team regularly reviews and updates its content to keep up with industry
changes and company developments, ensuring users always get current and reliable business insights.

## Routine Maintenance and Repair

Keep your equipment in good working order.

One of the key elements to successfully operate a laundromat is to have the equipment in good
working order. Not only you are not making money when the machine is out of order, you discouraging
the customers who don’t like to see broken washers or dryers especially during the rush hours. If
you are far from mechanics or have more important things to do, like drawing more business to your
laundry, CLS technicians can help. We take this burden off your shoulders, working out the schedule
of visits, once or twice a week and maintain your store in good order.

technicians are available on call basis as well. This requires more involvement of laundry personnel
and the owner of the laundromat into the maintenance routine. The history of units malfunctions
should be collected and made available to a service tech during his visits. The call should
preferably be made at least one day in advance, though emergency calls are also carried out.

## FAQs

Find answers to common questions about our services and how we can assist you.

How do you support local communities through your sourcing practices?

By partnering with local farmers and producers, we not only provide fresh ingredients but also
contribute to the economic growth of the communities we source from, promoting sustainability and
resilience.

What are your payment and contract terms?

We offer flexible payment options and contract terms to suit your needs. Please contact our sales
team for detailed information tailored to your specific situation.

Do you offer quotes?

Yes, we provide free quotes for our services. Simply fill out the quote request form, and we will
assess your needs. Expect a response within 24 hours.

What eco-friendly practices do you follow?

We prioritize sustainable sourcing, utilize biodegradable packaging, and collaborate with suppliers
who share our commitment to environmental responsibility. Our goal is to minimize waste and reduce
the carbon footprint of cruise operations.

Can you accommodate last-minute supply requests?

Yes! We have a responsive team that can handle urgent requests, ensuring you have what you need when
you need it.

### With **B&VIIT**

[ **

B&VIIT is a step into the future. I was very impressed by the technology you developed in both way
you created this AI system and the way you are able to gather the data from all those different
equipment. I think B&VIIT is doing all that is needed to be done now in this field. This AI system
has a sense if you can offer many options to the patients. If you only do PRK, it’s sense less to
have such systems behind you. So you basically do everything ranging from PRK to SMILE or refractive
lens exchange, or ICL. You have all the options on the table, which increases a lot of value of the
practice.I perceived the high quality of surgery selection even DNA testing which is really
fantastic!

** ][44]
[ **Chanyeol(EXO)** ][45] [ **Taeyeon(Girl's Generation)** ][46]
[ [140 x 140] **

I had my Toric ICL, Implantable Collamer Lens for astigmatism correction, for my vision correction
surgery last week. My vision was considered as profound loss vision. Many doctors said that it is
impossible for doing a surgery on my case. After heard that this hospital is having AI technology to
limit the subjective judgement error, I immediately reserved my first visit. For the post surgery, I
feel fabulous because the results comes out slightly beyond the target and now my vision is
considered as near normal vision! It is a miracle to made it happen! I am very grateful to Dr. Ryu,
who is excellent and really capable for the Implantable lens surgery; Ms. Rosa, the international
patient manager, who always be there to explain in details about everything related to the
examination and surgery; and the medical team for the thorough examination and hospitality. The
hospital also having a good design interior and modern new tools. Overall, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this
hospital for your vision correction surgery. Believe me, it is worth the money.

** ][47] [ [140 x 140] **

Probably the best decision in my life! 4 years ago, I was a bit reluctant to get the laser surgery
because it is not that common in my country (France). But living in Korea changed my mind and I
chose B&VIIT Eye Center to get SMILE Lasik surgery ! The medical service is just flawless. A huge
thank you to Rosa (International patient manager) who helped my through the whole process and also
to Dr. Han-nuy Choi for her professionalism and transparency. My vision went from 1/10 & 2/10 to
12/10 for both eyes.. Thank you!!!

** ][48]
[Read more][49]

### One-day Surgery

We can arrange the schedule for examination in the morning and surgery in the afternoon on the same
day for vision correction surgery.

### Contact Us

Please provide us with your email address so that we can send you all the necessary information
regarding the procedure.
* Ful

## About Exxelia, summary

Exxelia is a leading designer and manufacturer of high reliability passive components and precision
subsystems focusing on highly demanding markets, applications and functions.

Exxelia product portfolio includes wide ranges of **capacitors, magnetics, resistors, bus bars,
filters, position sensors, slip rings and high-precision mechanical parts.** Products are commonly
used for power electronics, power generation, energy storage, and signal filtering functions in
numerous leading industrial areas.

Exxelia is valued for its ability to meet complex specifications and develop standard and custom
products complying with the most demanding qualifications (MIL, ESA).

## Ophthalmologist and Eye Diseases

An ophthalmologist (eye doctor) is a doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and
prevention of eye disease. It is difficult to overestimate the severity of vision problems - a large
part of the surrounding world ceases to exist for a person. Treating and preventing private and
total loss of vision is what an ophthalmologist does.

## Subsections of ophthalmology

Pediatric ophthalmology is a subsection of ophthalmology that investigates the characteristics of
children's vision. A child's vision, unlike that of an adult, is constantly changing. Pediatric
ophthalmology is designed to study the peculiarities of these changes and related pathologies.

## What organs do ophthalmologists treat
* The eyeball;
* eyelids;
* lacrimal organs;
* conjunctiva;
* orbit.

## What diseases are treated by an ophthalmologist
* [nearsightedness][8] is a visual defect in which the image is focused in front of the retina and
  the person cannot see distant objects clearly;
* farsightedness is a visual defect in which the image is focused behind the retina and a person
  cannot see objects clearly at close range;
* [conjunctivitis][9] - inflammation of the mucous membrane of the eye (conjunctiva);
* [cataract][10] - clouding of the lens of the eye;
* [glaucoma][11] - increased eye pressure that causes visual impairment;
* [astigmatism][12] - a disturbance in the shape of the lens or cornea.

## What else does an ophthalmologist treat?

A large part of what an ophthalmologist treats are vision abnormalities that are triggered by other
diseases or critical situations for the body. Visual impairment can be caused by:
* hypertension;
* abnormal pregnancy;
* severe childbirth;
* atherosclerosis;
* renal pathologies;
* diabetes mellitus;
* traumatic eye injuries.

## How is the examination by an ophthalmologist?

At the initial reception, the ophthalmologist:
* Gathers anamnesis (medical history), asks the patient about possible complaints.
* Conducts examination and palpation (palpation) of the eyes, examination of the eyes with a
  biomicroscope (slit lamp).
* Depending on complaints and examination results, the doctor may prescribe additional tests:
  ophthalmoscopy (visual examination of the eye fundus), tonometry (measuring intraocular pressure),
  and biomicroscopy (examination of the eye under multiple magnification).

## Ophthalmologist and Eye Diseases

An ophthalmologist (eye doctor) is a doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and
prevention of eye disease. It is difficult to overestimate the severity of vision problems - a large
part of the surrounding world ceases to exist for a person. Treating and preventing private and
total loss of vision is what an ophthalmologist does.

## Subsections of ophthalmology

Pediatric ophthalmology is a subsection of ophthalmology that investigates the characteristics of
children's vision. A child's vision, unlike that of an adult, is constantly changing. Pediatric
ophthalmology is designed to study the peculiarities of these changes and related pathologies.

## What organs do ophthalmologists treat
* The eyeball;
* eyelids;
* lacrimal organs;
* conjunctiva;
* orbit.

## What diseases are treated by an ophthalmologist
* [nearsightedness][8] is a visual defect in which the image is focused in front of the retina and
  the person cannot see distant objects clearly;
* farsightedness is a visual defect in which the image is focused behind the retina and a person
  cannot see objects clearly at close range;
* [conjunctivitis][9] - inflammation of the mucous membrane of the eye (conjunctiva);
* [cataract][10] - clouding of the lens of the eye;
* [glaucoma][11] - increased eye pressure that causes visual impairment;
* [astigmatism][12] - a disturbance in the shape of the lens or cornea.

## What else does an ophthalmologist treat?

A large part of what an ophthalmologist treats are vision abnormalities that are triggered by other
diseases or critical situations for the body. Visual impairment can be caused by:
* hypertension;
* abnormal pregnancy;
* severe childbirth;
* atherosclerosis;
* renal pathologies;
* diabetes mellitus;
* traumatic eye injuries.

## How is the examination by an ophthalmologist?

At the initial reception, the ophthalmologist:
* Gathers anamnesis (medical history), asks the patient about possible complaints.
* Conducts examination and palpation (palpation) of the eyes, examination of the eyes with a
  biomicroscope (slit lamp).
* Depending on complaints and examination results, the doctor may prescribe additional tests:
  ophthalmoscopy (visual examination of the eye fundus), tonometry (measuring intraocular pressure),
  and biomicroscopy (examination of the eye under multiple magnification).

“Since age six I’ve worn glasses and contact lenses. I was the guy who couldn’t see the “Big E” on
the chart. Finally, I heard about PRK about 10 years ago. I immediately investigated only to be
disappointed to learn that my vision was well beyond the possibility of correction through PRK. When
LASIK was approved, I was ready in a heartbeat…and couldn’t be happier with the results. I see
clearly….no need for contacts or lenses and wholeheartedly endorse and recommend the procedure to
all my friends and associates. For me, the entire process has been a dream come true.”

WROR Radion Station 105.7, Boston MA

# LASIK Eye Surgery in Jacksonville

Among one of the first eye surgeons in the world to be exposed to Excimer laser vision surgery,
while LASIK surgeons in the USA started performing LASIK surgery in 1995, Dr. Gulani had already
become a LASIK instructor for surgeons worldwide and invented award-winning LASIK surgical
instruments and proprietary protocols. He quickly elevated to a top LASIK surgeon in Jacksonville
and was recognized as one of the Jacksonville LASIK pioneers. He differentiated himself in
Jacksonville because of his multiple LASIK techniques designed to enhance personal best vision for
his patients. It did not take long for Dr. Gulani to gain worldwide credibility.

Over three decades of continued innovation with an enviable track record of success along with his
award-winning inventions, publications and international teachings to colleagues globally especially
having consistent success with some of the most varied and complex Lasik cases from all over the
world have resulted in Dr. Gulani’s “no-cut’, “no-blade”, “no-flap” surgery: NexGen Lasik & LaZr
Plastique™ surgery.

Providing a full range of Laser Vision surgeries including Lasik, Bladeless Lasik, Laser ASA, Lasek,
EpiLasik, SBK,PRK, PTK, Wavefront Lasik, NexGen Lasik and LaZrplastique for patients with Myopia
(Nearsightedness), Hyperopia (Farsightedness), Astigmatism and Presbyopia (reading glasses),
Dr.Gulani uniquely designs more than Lasik surgery to maximize each patient’s vision potential in
many cases even beyond 20/20.

Whether you are traveling from thousands of miles away or locally for Jacksonville LASIK surgeon,
Dr.Gulani, we look forward to welcoming you to Gulani Vision Institute, where your vision, is our
passion!

## Cataract Surgery

called a “Routine” procedure by many doctors, Dr. Gulani teaches eye surgeons worldwide that “No
Cataract surgery should be ROUTINE”.

“Cataract surgery is an endeavor to help patients See what they have been missing & also an
opportunity to plan for the BEST Vision they can have for the REST of their Life”- Dr.Gulani

With such a dedicated outlook, Dr. Gulani encourages eye doctors to classify every Cataract patient
into specific categories and then individually plan to address all of their correctable visual
issues using Customized Cataract Surgery with cutting edge technology and Lens Implants.

**LenzOplastique™** (the “**O**” stands for “**O**ptimized Vision”): Raising Cataract Surgery to an
**ART**, Dr. Gulani’s relentless pursuit to design vision and lend artistry to surgery raises even
cataract surgery to his proprietary approach called **LenzOplastique™** where he personally studies
all patient diagnostics and measurements including anatomy , physiology, optics and vision potential
to diligently apply his vast array of lens based surgical technologies and techniques along with his
“Vision A La Carte” concept to customize surgery in a holistic approach individually tailored to
each eye no matter how simple or complex it is and also in combination surgical concepts.

Unlike most practices that offer three lens implant choices, Dr.Gulani with his international
privileges has experience with over 30 lens implant choices including Trifocal, Panoptix, ReStor,
Rezoom, Crystalens, Envista, Tecnis, Symfony, multifocal, pseudo-accommodative, progressive, toric
and monofocal along with piggyback, secondary and phakic implants.

Therefore, after studying your eye’s anatomy, physiology, optics and visual capacity in synch with
your neural (Brain) potential becomes Dr.Gulani’s goal.

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

### LASIK Eye Surgery

Laser-Assisted In-Situ Keratomileusis, or LASIK, is an FDA-approved refractive laser procedure
designed to lessen a patient's dependence on glasses and contact lenses. LASIK surgery is commonly
used to treat myopia (nearsighted), hyperopia (farsighted), and astigmatism. At the Kraff Eye
Institute, we utilize the iDesign 2.0 wavefront-guided software which helps Dr. Kraff achieve highly
accurate results, and unprecedented safety. Trust Kraff Eye laser vision center for the best LASIK
procedures in Chicago. We believe in empowering our patients with comprehensive education about
their options, ensuring informed decisions and the highest standard of vision care. Experience the
clarity and freedom that comes with world-class LASIK surgery at Kraff Eye Institute.

cornea, enhancing visual clarity and reducing the need for glasses or contacts. With personalized
care and a commitment to excellence, Kraff Eye Institute helps patients achieve lasting visual
freedom and a renewed zest for life. Our comprehensive approach ensures that each patient receives a
tailored treatment plan, focusing on safety, comfort, and optimal outcomes. Experience the world
with new clarity and embrace the possibilities of a life less dependent on corrective eyewear.

designed to lessen a patient's dependence on glasses and contact lenses. LASIK surgery is commonly
used to treat myopia (nearsighted), hyperopia (farsighted), and astigmatism. At the Kraff Eye
Institute, we utilize the iDesign 2.0 wavefront-guided software which helps Dr. Kraff achieve highly
accurate results, and unprecedented safety. Trust Kraff Eye laser vision center for the best LASIK
procedures in Chicago. We believe in empowering our patients with comprehensive education about
their options, ensuring informed decisions and the highest standard of vision care. Experience the
clarity and freedom that comes with world-class LASIK surgery at Kraff Eye Institute.

# **Eye Equipment – A new way to shop!
# **

#### As one of the premiere source’s of new and pre-owned ophthalmic equipment in the entire
#### Ophthalmic industry.

At Ophthalmic Equipment Specialists it’s our mission is to provide an unsurpassed experience for
each of our new and existing clients that equals or surpasses the service and selection of new or
pre-owned refurbished ophthalmic equipment. Our extensive knowledge of the equipment will allow you,
the eye care professional, to use our expertise and knowledge to help you select the products that
are right for your practice.

So the next time you are in the market for any new or pre-owned refurbished ophthalmic equipment,
from Phoroptors, to Auto Refractors to Auto Lensometers, to Edgers even to complete exam lanes give
Ophthalmic Equipment Specialist a call. We will be happy to answer any question that you may have
regarding your equipment needs, equipment suggestions, even room layout and designs..we are here to
help.

### New and Pre-owned

**At Ophthalmic Equipment Specialists**, we sell both New and Pre Owned/ Refurbished Equipment. We
carry all the top name brands that you are accustomed to using in your practice everyday. From
Diagnostic Equipment, to Exam Lane equipment, to Pretest Equipment to Lab equipment, we carry it all
for your 1 stop shop convenience.

### Sell and Trade Ins

**At Ophthalmic Equipment Specialists**, we will buy your used unused equipment. Maybe you are
looking to just sell it or maybe you are looking to upgrade it. Call us to trade it in on new
equipment for your practice. All Pre Owned Refurbished equipment that we sell will have gone through
a vigorous refurbishment process followed by an inspection process and sold and backed by an
industry leading warranty.

### Customer Service

At Ophthalmic Equipment Specialists, we pride our self on Customer Service and support, not only
during the sale but after the sale. Our equipment in your office with our reputation on the line
every day is what drives us to be the best in the industry. Call us for your next equipment needs
and come join our family to see the difference and what you and your practice have been missing.

Glaucoma is the leading cause of blindness, and the outlook for treatment is best at the onset of

Laser vision correction surgery can provide you with clear vision without eyewear. Find out how

Low vision can be in the form of moderate vision impairment, blind spots or tunnel vision, legal
blindness, or total blindness that leaves you with partial sight. But the proper medical attention
can correct this condition fully or partially.

Established in 1984, Northeastern Eye Institute was the first in our region to offer laser vision
correction services such as LASIK and PRK. Known as pioneers in vision correction, our
board-certified ophthalmologists and optometrists continuously integrate new technology into our
practices, enabling us to provide the safest and most effective vision correction and vision-saving
procedures available. We welcome any opportunity to meet with you for a one-on-one consultation to
discuss your eye care needs, our services, and the ways we can help you reach optimal visual health.
No matter if you are looking for routine eye care services or are in need of comprehensive treatment
for diseases such as cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, or diabetic retinopathy, our caring
and reliable eye doctors have you covered.

Established in 1984, Northeastern Eye Institute was the first in our region to offer laser vision
correction services such as LASIK and PRK. Known as pioneers in vision correction, our
board-certified ophthalmologists and optometrists continuously integrate new technology into our
practices, enabling us to provide the safest and most effective vision correction and vision-saving
procedures available. We welcome any opportunity to meet with you for a one-on-one consultation to
discuss your eye care needs, our services, and the ways we can help you reach optimal visual health.
No matter if you are looking for routine eye care services or are in need of comprehensive treatment
for diseases such as cataracts, glaucoma, macular degeneration, or diabetic retinopathy, our caring
and reliable eye doctors have you covered.

## Vision Correction Solutions For All Ages

Your vision needs change as you age. At NVISION, we have options to treat the most common vision
problems for each stage of life.

[Vision options for ages 18-45]

### Ages 18 - 45

Whether it’s sports, outdoor adventures, travel, or simply wanting the confidence of clear vision
without the hassle of glasses or contacts, laser vision correction is an appealing option at this
stage of life.

Struggling to see objects up close or far away? These procedures may be right for you:
[LASIK Eye Surgery][263][Contoura LASIK Eye Surgery][264][EVO ICL][265][Photorefractive Keratectomy
(PRK)][266]
[Vision options for ages 45-60]

### Ages 45 - 60

Between work, hobbies, and caring for growing families, the idea of life without glasses or contacts
can be especially appealing. Plus, many people in their 40s experience a new vision change—reliance
on reading glasses.

Struggling to see objects up close, far away, or read fine print? These procedures may be right for
you:
[Photorefractive Keratectomy (PRK)][267][Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)][268][SMILE Eye
Surgery][269]
[Vision options for ages 60 and beyond]

### 60s and Beyond

As we age, the eye’s lens hardens, a condition known as cataracts. Cataracts are a normal part of
aging and affect everyone. At NVISION, we offer the most advanced treatment options for cataract
removal.

Struggling to see clearly because of cataracts or glaucoma? These procedures may be right for you:
[Cataract Surgery][270][Lifestyle Lenses][271][iDose® TR for Glaucoma][272][Glaucoma Surgery][273]

## Vision Correction Solutions For All Ages

Your vision needs change as you age. At NVISION, we have options to treat the most common vision
problems for each stage of life.

[Vision options for ages 18-45]

### Ages 18 - 45

Whether it’s sports, outdoor adventures, travel, or simply wanting the confidence of clear vision
without the hassle of glasses or contacts, laser vision correction is an appealing option at this
stage of life.

Struggling to see objects up close or far away? These procedures may be right for you:
[LASIK Eye Surgery][263][Contoura LASIK Eye Surgery][264][EVO ICL][265][Photorefractive Keratectomy
(PRK)][266]
[Vision options for ages 45-60]

### Ages 45 - 60

Between work, hobbies, and caring for growing families, the idea of life without glasses or contacts
can be especially appealing. Plus, many people in their 40s experience a new vision change—reliance
on reading glasses.

Struggling to see objects up close, far away, or read fine print? These procedures may be right for
you:
[Photorefractive Keratectomy (PRK)][267][Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)][268][SMILE Eye
Surgery][269]
[Vision options for ages 60 and beyond]

### 60s and Beyond

As we age, the eye’s lens hardens, a condition known as cataracts. Cataracts are a normal part of
aging and affect everyone. At NVISION, we offer the most advanced treatment options for cataract
removal.

Struggling to see clearly because of cataracts or glaucoma? These procedures may be right for you:
[Cataract Surgery][270][Lifestyle Lenses][271][iDose® TR for Glaucoma][272][Glaucoma Surgery][273]

## Frequently Asked Questions

You can find answers to some of our most frequently asked questions about LASIK procedures.

What will happen during my LASIK evaluation?

Plan to be at doctor’s office for approximately 1-2 hours for the exam and special testing used to
measure and evaluate your eyes. If you wear contact lenses prior to your scheduled evaluation, you
may be asked to refrain from wearing contact lenses for a specified period of time. Your eyes may be
dilated in preparation of a detailed eye exam that will evaluate refractive error, pupil size and
corneal evaluations. There will be a thorough discussion of LASIK eye surgery and whether you may be
a potential candidate.

How long will vision correction last?

Your distance vision is fairly permanent following laser vision correction. The goal of laser vision
correction is to reduce or eliminate your dependence on glasses and contact lenses. The need for
reading glasses is a normal age related change and laser vision correction does not change this.

How soon after surgery can I resume normal activities?

There are minimal restrictions in the first weeks following LASIK. Many patients are able to resume
normal activities the following day. Vision results from LASIK can vary, but most patients are able
to see clearly 24-48 hours after surgery. Further vision improvement may continue over several
months. Your doctor will recommend avoiding certain activities, like swimming or contact sports for
several weeks.

How does PRK compare to LASIK?

PRK and LASIK surgery have comparable results and your doctor can discuss which is most appropriate
for your condition during your evaluation. A major difference is LASIK surgery creates a hinged flap
on the cornea. LASIK patients report minimal irritation and their vision stabilizes more quickly
than PRK. PRK involves treating the surface of the cornea. PRK recovery takes a few days with hazy
vision and some discomfort. It is often recommended when the patient’s cornea is too thin for LASIK.

## Frequently Asked Questions

You can find answers to some of our most frequently asked questions about LASIK procedures.

What will happen during my LASIK evaluation?

Plan to be at doctor’s office for approximately 1-2 hours for the exam and special testing used to
measure and evaluate your eyes. If you wear contact lenses prior to your scheduled evaluation, you
may be asked to refrain from wearing contact lenses for a specified period of time. Your eyes may be
dilated in preparation of a detailed eye exam that will evaluate refractive error, pupil size and
corneal evaluations. There will be a thorough discussion of LASIK eye surgery and whether you may be
a potential candidate.

How long will vision correction last?

Your distance vision is fairly permanent following laser vision correction. The goal of laser vision
correction is to reduce or eliminate your dependence on glasses and contact lenses. The need for
reading glasses is a normal age related change and laser vision correction does not change this.

How soon after surgery can I resume normal activities?

There are minimal restrictions in the first weeks following LASIK. Many patients are able to resume
normal activities the following day. Vision results from LASIK can vary, but most patients are able
to see clearly 24-48 hours after surgery. Further vision improvement may continue over several
months. Your doctor will recommend avoiding certain activities, like swimming or contact sports for
several weeks.

How does PRK compare to LASIK?

PRK and LASIK surgery have comparable results and your doctor can discuss which is most appropriate
for your condition during your evaluation. A major difference is LASIK surgery creates a hinged flap
on the cornea. LASIK patients report minimal irritation and their vision stabilizes more quickly
than PRK. PRK involves treating the surface of the cornea. PRK recovery takes a few days with hazy
vision and some discomfort. It is often recommended when the patient’s cornea is too thin for LASIK.

# Laser Eye Surgery & Vision Correction in The Bay Area

Gain freedom from glasses & contact lenses through our comprehensive laser eye surgery, including
LASIK, SMILE, EVO ICL, RLE, and PRK procedures in our San Francisco, San Jose, and San Ramon
clinics.

[Schedule Your Free Consultation][42]

## Leaders in Laser Vision Correction: Precision Results for Clearer Vision

Are you fed up with prescription glasses and contact lenses? Do you want to play sports or go
swimming without worrying about losing or damaging your glasses? If so, you may be a strong
candidate for laser vision correction. This simple, effective procedure often restores patients’
vision fully.

## Focused on safely optimizing your visual outcome

YOUR SURGEON’S INVESTMENT IN YOUR PRE-OPERATIVE CARE CAN BE A KEY DIFFERENCE

Our team is deeply involved in every step of your pre-operative care, from meeting with you at the
[consultation][43] to analyzing your prescription and corneal imaging data to formulating your
surgical plan.Not all laser eye surgeons are so comprehensively invested in the patient’s pre-op
care, but we believe that investment can pay-off in a superior visual outcome.

[eye-examination]
[still-life-ophthalmologist]

## The Benefits of LASIK

Laser vision correction is considered one of the most life-changing elective procedures available
today. Key benefits include:
* **Freedom from glasses and contact lenses** for most daily activities
* **Long-term cost savings** by reducing or eliminating ongoing costs of prescriptions, frames, and
  contacts
* **Rapid results**, with many patients noticing improved vision within 24 hours
* **Permanent correction** of refractive errors in a single short procedure
* **High patient satisfaction rates**, with the majority of patients achieving 20/20 vision or
  better
* **Improved quality of life** for sports, travel, and active lifestyles

“All-Laser” LASIK offers several advantages over traditional LASIK procedures that use a blade.
Thanks to femtosecond technology, one of those advantages is that “All Laser” LASIK employs a
femtosecond laser to create the LASIK corneal flap, which is the first step in the “All Laser” LASIK
procedure.

By using a laser rather than a mechanical keratome (i.e., a surgical blade) to produce the flap,
surgeons are able to better control the quality of the flap without exposing the patient to the
unique risks associated with using the mechanical keratome. In using a laser to create the flap and
wavefront-optimized techniques to correct the patient’s vision error, “All Laser” LASIK gives
patients a chance to see equal to or potentially better than their glasses and contact lenses.

## What is Laser Vision Correction?

Laser vision correction is an advanced procedure that permanently restores a patient’s vision by
reshaping the cornea using specialized lasers. Also known as laser eye surgery, it is an umbrella
term covering several distinct treatment options.

Laser vision correction can permanently correct common refractive errors including nearsightedness
(myopia), farsightedness (hyperopia), and astigmatism, which is an imperfection in the eye’s
curvature. For many patients, it provides a path to 20/20 vision or better, eliminating the need for
glasses or contact lenses.

While the specific technique varies by treatment, most procedures use specialized femtosecond and
excimer lasers to alter the shape of the cornea. The cornea is the clear, transparent window at the
front of the eye that focuses light onto the retina. Treatment is typically completed in around 15
minutes and is completely painless thanks to anesthetic eye drops. Recovery time varies depending on
the procedure chosen.

correction procedures, going well above and beyond many other providers in the Bay Area. This allows

### Wavefront-Optimized “All Laser” LASIK

[Wavefront-Optimized LASIK][62] uses two different lasers to reshape the cornea with exceptional
precision. Before the procedure, Wavefront Technology Mapping creates a detailed 3D map of each
patient’s eyes, pinpointing the specific aberrations causing blurry vision. A femtosecond laser then
creates a precise, uniform corneal flap, allowing a second excimer laser to reshape the cornea based
on the 3D map data. This procedure offers a fast recovery, with most patients returning to work the
next day.

Small Incision Lenticule Extraction (SMILE) is a minimally invasive option for patients with
nearsightedness or astigmatism. Rather than creating a large corneal flap, a specialized laser forms

## A service model that prioritizes flexibility, support, and execution

Operational capabilities are designed to make deployment simpler while preserving confidence in

### Launch in 30 to 60 days

Start or expand a cataract program quickly without waiting on internal capital approval cycles or
equipment procurement.

### No capital expense

Avoid $500K+ equipment purchases, maintenance contracts, and supply chain management. Pay per case,
not per quarter.

### Certified technologists and laser engineers

Stop competing for scarce eye techs. We bring eye-only technologists trained to one standard, so you
don't have to recruit or retain them. Every deployment includes the right specialist for the
procedure: certified surgical technologists for cataract and retina cases, dedicated laser engineers
for femto and refractive cases.

### 99% equipment uptime

Our lasers are calibrated every day and run at 99% uptime, often better maintained than equipment
that sits idle in one room. Manufacturer-trained field teams stay on-site during surgery day, backed
by 9+ year average customer relationships.

Technology choice

## Vendor neutral. Surgeon driven.

Sightpath is not tied to any single equipment manufacturer. Our agnostic approach means we support
facilities with the technology surgeons actually want to use, not whatever a single vendor sells.

### Surgeon preference, not vendor lock-in

Surgeons get the platforms they trust and prefer to operate on. We bring the equipment to match
their workflow, not the other way around.

### Access to leading technology

Because we partner across the industry, your facility gets access to the latest phaco, femto,
excimer, and laser systems, without betting on a single manufacturer's roadmap.

### Future-proof your program

Equipment obsolescence is no longer your problem. As technology evolves, we evolve with it, bringing
newer platforms to your OR without you re-investing in capital. We grow with you from a single
surgery day to a fixed install, a long-term partner, not a stopgap.

deliver the technology, support, and consistency they need.

Reeve Woods Eye Center

“Sightpath has allowed me to stay on the cutting-edge of eye surgery so I can provide the best
possible care for my patients. To achieve a consistency of care at all locations where I perform
surgery, I partner with Sightpath.”

Jitendra Swarup, MD

Albemarle Eye Center

Elizabeth City, NC

[Close-up of an eye with the Sightpath Medical 'Focused on what matters' brand mark]

Sightpath combines patented transport, manufacturer-trained service expertise, and long-standing
field execution so facilities can access advanced cataract and refractive technology (through
whichever deployment model fits their workflow) without taking on the full burden of ownership,
maintenance, and storage.

First to mobilize phaco in 1991, excimer lasers after LASIK approval, and later IntraLase, LenSx,
Centurion, and iFS systems

## Press Release | Dr. Boutros Named One of the “Best Cataract Surgeons In America”

[Best-Cataract-Surgeons]

**July 26, 2022 – Dr. Ayman Boutros of “The Eye Center” in Sterling, Virginia, has been named one of
the “Best Cataract Surgeons in America”. **

The “Best Cataract Surgeons in America” recognition is awarded to surgeons who exemplify excellence
in modern cataract surgery.“ [Dr. Ayman Boutros][63] has been named one of the “Best Cataract
Surgeons in America” for his vast experience and attention to superior patient outcomes &
experiences. He delivers state-of-the-art care to the patients of Virginia and Washington D.C.

Cataract surgery has advanced tremendously over the past 20 years. Dr. Boutros has shown a
dedication to remaining on the forefront of modern cataract surgery, as an expert in
advanced-technology lens implants, and as an early-adopter of technologies that improve patient
outcomes. With the first in-office surgical suite in the state of Virginia, he has once again
demonstrated that he is a leader in modern cataract surgery, and gone above and beyond to deliver
his patients an improved patient experience,” said Dr. Michael J. Shumski, Medical Director of Best
Cataract Surgeons, and a cataract surgeon in Orlando, Florida.

In addition to modern cataract surgery, Dr. Boutros is one of the most experienced laser refractive
surgeons in the country, having started performing refractive surgery in 1989. Over these years he
has been an acclaimed speaker, panelist at academic conferences, and teacher of other surgeons.
Having the added expertise of being a laser vision correction specialist is another skill that
differentiates Dr. Boutros, and is a benefit to patients interested in the best possible outcome in
modern cataract surgery. [Read more about Dr. Boutros][64]

cataract exam at one of our five convenient [locations][65].

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

## Visual Freedom

#### We’re the [Official LASIK Surgeons of The Texas Rangers][45]

Living with vision problems can be incredibly challenging, often turning everyday tasks into
daunting obstacles. We understand the difficulties you face navigating a world that may seem blurry
or unclear, and we are here to guide you through each step towards improved eye health.

This journey starts when you book a consultation with one of our experts and leads to the ultimate
goal: your relief and the clarity of vision you deserve.

# Premier LASIK Surgeons in Irving and McKinney, TX

[
LASIK

LASIK is a safe and effective laser surgery that corrects refractive errors causing blurry vision,
eliminating the need for glasses or contacts.

][47]
[
EVO ICL

EVO is a special type of lens used to correct myopia and astigmatism without the need to remove
corneal tissue. This painless procedure is quick, has a short recovery time, and does not require
reshaping the cornea.

][48]
[
PRK

Photorefractive Keratectomy (PRK) is a type of refractive surgery that utilizes a laser to reshape
the cornea. This procedure is suitable for patients with thin corneas, dry eye, or other conditions
that may disqualify them for LASIK.

][49]
[
REFRACTIVE LENS EXCHANGE

Refractive Lens Exchange, also known as RLE, is a procedure that can improve vision by replacing the
eye’s natural lens with an artificial intraocular lens, also called an IOL

][50]
[
MODERN LASER CATARACT

Cataracts naturally develop as we age, leading to cloudy lenses, blurry vision, and reduced color
perception. Our specialists can surgically remove the clouded natural lens and replace it with a
clear artificial one to restore your vision.

][51]

## Not Just Another Optical Shop

If you've ever felt rushed through an eye exam, overwhelmed by endless frame choices, or
disappointed that every optical store carries the same styles, you're not alone.



Urban Optiks was built for people who want something better: thoughtful eye care, expert guidance,
and eyewear that reflects their personality - not the latest mass-market trend.



For more than 16 years, we've helped San Diegans see better, look better, and feel confident in
eyewear they truly love.

[ Get To Know Us ][185]

## A Place You'll Actually Enjoy Visiting

Most optical stores feel clinical. Others feel like retail chains. We wanted something different.



Our Hillcrest boutique was designed to feel welcoming, creative, and personal - filled with natural
materials, living plants, and carefully selected details that reflect the same individuality found
in our eyewear collection.

﻿

The moment you walk in, you'll know you're somewhere different.

[ Tour Our Store ][186]

## For People Who Want More Than Ordinary Frames

The average optical store carries many of the same brands. We don't.



Our collection focuses on independent designers and handcrafted eyewear from around the world with
frames chosen for their design, craftsmanship, and individuality.



Whether your style is bold, artistic, understated, classic, or somewhere in between, we'll help you
find eyewear that feels uniquely yours.



Because glasses aren't just something you wear. They're part of how you present yourself to the
world.

[ Explore Our Framelines ][187]

## Why Patients Keep Coming Back

Many of our patients first visit us because they're looking for something different. They stay
because of the experience.

﻿

From first-time visitors to patients who've trusted us for years, we're proud to have earned
hundreds of five-star reviews from people who appreciate personalized care, unique eyewear, and a
team that genuinely values relationships.

[ Read Our Reviews ][188]

## Trusted By San Diego For More Than 16 Years

We're honored to have been recognized by readers, patients, and local publications as one of San
Diego's favorite destinations for eyewear and eye care.

﻿

But awards aren't what drive us. Helping people feel confident in their vision, and in the eyewear
they wear every day, is what matters most.

[ Check Out Our Awards ][189]

## You Deserve More Than a Transaction

That's why we take the time to understand how you live, work, and see the world before making
recommendations.



No pressure. No rushing. No being handed off from person to person.



Just genuine expertise and personalized attention from a team that truly cares about getting it
right.

[ Make An Appointment ][190]

## Better Technology. Better Vision.

You shouldn't have to choose between personalized care and advanced technology. At Urban Optiks, we
combine both.



Our state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment allows us to provide highly accurate prescriptions,
advanced eye health evaluations, and digitally customized lens solutions - all designed to help you
see as clearly and comfortably as possible.



Because exceptional eyewear starts with exceptional vision.

[ Discover Our Technology ][191]

## Experts in Eyewear. Focused on You.

Finding the right eyewear is about more than choosing a frame. It's about finding something that
complements your vision, your lifestyle, and your personality.



Our experienced doctors and opticians take the time to understand what matters most to you, offering
expert guidance and personalized recommendations every step of the way.

[ Meet Our Team ][192]

## Ready to Find Eyewear That Feels Like You?

Whether you're looking for a comprehensive eye exam, searching for your next favorite frame, or
simply curious about what makes Urban Optiks different, we'd love to welcome you. Come experience
eye care and eyewear the way it should be.

[ Make An Appointment ][193]

## Not Just Another Optical Shop

If you've ever felt rushed through an eye exam, overwhelmed by endless frame choices, or
disappointed that every optical store carries the same styles, you're not alone.



Urban Optiks was built for people who want something better: thoughtful eye care, expert guidance,
and eyewear that reflects their personality - not the latest mass-market trend.



For more than 16 years, we've helped San Diegans see better, look better, and feel confident in
eyewear they truly love.

[ Get To Know Us ][185]

## A Place You'll Actually Enjoy Visiting

Most optical stores feel clinical. Others feel like retail chains. We wanted something different.



Our Hillcrest boutique was designed to feel welcoming, creative, and personal - filled with natural
materials, living plants, and carefully selected details that reflect the same individuality found
in our eyewear collection.

﻿

The moment you walk in, you'll know you're somewhere different.

[ Tour Our Store ][186]

## For People Who Want More Than Ordinary Frames

The average optical store carries many of the same brands. We don't.



Our collection focuses on independent designers and handcrafted eyewear from around the world with
frames chosen for their design, craftsmanship, and individuality.



Whether your style is bold, artistic, understated, classic, or somewhere in between, we'll help you
find eyewear that feels uniquely yours.



Because glasses aren't just something you wear. They're part of how you present yourself to the
world.

[ Explore Our Framelines ][187]

## Why Patients Keep Coming Back

Many of our patients first visit us because they're looking for something different. They stay
because of the experience.

﻿

From first-time visitors to patients who've trusted us for years, we're proud to have earned
hundreds of five-star reviews from people who appreciate personalized care, unique eyewear, and a
team that genuinely values relationships.

[ Read Our Reviews ][188]

## Trusted By San Diego For More Than 16 Years

We're honored to have been recognized by readers, patients, and local publications as one of San
Diego's favorite destinations for eyewear and eye care.

﻿

But awards aren't what drive us. Helping people feel confident in their vision, and in the eyewear
they wear every day, is what matters most.

[ Check Out Our Awards ][189]

## You Deserve More Than a Transaction

That's why we take the time to understand how you live, work, and see the world before making
recommendations.



No pressure. No rushing. No being handed off from person to person.



Just genuine expertise and personalized attention from a team that truly cares about getting it
right.

[ Make An Appointment ][190]

## Better Technology. Better Vision.

You shouldn't have to choose between personalized care and advanced technology. At Urban Optiks, we
combine both.



Our state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment allows us to provide highly accurate prescriptions,
advanced eye health evaluations, and digitally customized lens solutions - all designed to help you
see as clearly and comfortably as possible.



Because exceptional eyewear starts with exceptional vision.

[ Discover Our Technology ][191]

## Experts in Eyewear. Focused on You.

Finding the right eyewear is about more than choosing a frame. It's about finding something that
complements your vision, your lifestyle, and your personality.



Our experienced doctors and opticians take the time to understand what matters most to you, offering
expert guidance and personalized recommendations every step of the way.

[ Meet Our Team ][192]

## Ready to Find Eyewear That Feels Like You?

Whether you're looking for a comprehensive eye exam, searching for your next favorite frame, or
simply curious about what makes Urban Optiks different, we'd love to welcome you. Come experience
eye care and eyewear the way it should be.

## Vasan Eye Care – A Leading Eye Hospital in India

Clear vision shapes how people work, learn, and live each day. When eyesight changes, timely medical
care becomes essential. At Vasan Eye Care, patients receive diagnosis, treatment, and surgical care
for a wide range of eye conditions under one roof.

Recognized as a leading eye hospital, Vasan Eye Care brings together modern technology, established
clinical practices, and a patient-first approach. With a strong presence across several cities, the
network of eye hospitals in India makes specialized vision care accessible to patients who need
reliable diagnosis and treatment.

From routine eye examinations to advanced procedures such as refractive surgery and cataract
removal, every treatment is guided by careful evaluation and clear communication with patients. The
goal is simple – help people regain and maintain healthy vision with dependable care.

As an eye specialist hospital, Vasan Eye Care focuses exclusively on ophthalmology. This allows the
team to concentrate on accurate diagnosis, efficient treatment plans, and consistent patient care
across all centres.

## Why Choose Vasan Eye Care as Your Eye Hospital?

Choosing the right eye hospital is an important decision. Vision treatment requires precision,
careful diagnosis, and ongoing monitoring. At Vasan Eye Care, several factors come together to

## Cataract Surgery in Los Angeles

When it comes to the quality of your vision, and finding the best cataract surgeon in Los Angeles,
we understand that nothing is more important to you than choosing the most skilled and caring eye
surgeon. We invite you to read more about Barry S. Seibel, MD  and his approach to cataract surgery
in Los Angeles, CA, and patient care, continually expanding his knowledge base and refining his
surgical skills – all for your best possible experience!

## Professor

## Professor

In worldwide demand to share his expertise on Phacodynamics and customized cataract surgery, Dr.
Seibel has delivered over 300 lectures in more than 20 countries on six continents. He has produced
numerous educational videos, and his live surgery demonstrations have been televised internationally
to doctors wishing to learn Dr. Seibel’s methods.
[ Learn more ][174]

## Author

## Author

Barry S. Seibel, M.D. is the sole author and illustrator of his critically acclaimed textbook
“Phacodynamics”, often called the bible of cataract surgery. With four editions and four
translations, it uniquely applies engineering principles in a clinically practical manner to
facilitate the safest and gentlest customized surgery for each individual patient.
[ Learn more ][175]

## Inventor

## Inventor

Dr. Seibel has applied the engineering principles from his textbook Phacodynamics to the design of
20 surgical instruments with the goal of enhanced safety and comfort for his patients, and enhanced
effectiveness for surgeons worldwide. As Dr. Seibel explains, "The development of each of the Seibel
surgical instruments occurred while applying Phacodynamics principles to cataract and LASIK surgery.
[ Learn more ][176]

## Pioneer

## Pioneer

Dr. Barry Seibel pioneered laser cataract surgery at his Los Angeles ophthalmology practice while
deeply involved in the research, development, and FDA approval of this exciting new technology. Dr.
Seibel is the first Southern California eye surgeon to have performed cataract surgery with the
Catalys femtosecond laser that offers patients enhanced precision and accuracy.
[ Learn more ][177]


## [ Why Choose
## Seibel Vision Surgery ][178]

Known as one of the best cataract surgeons in Los Angeles, Dr. Seibel prioritizes understanding over
memorization in ophthalmology, focusing on individual patient goals and holistic assessment. He
customizes every surgical moment using his textbook "Phacodynamics" principles and his own surgical
instrument innovations. Unparalleled Experience and Rigorous Quality Control: From the initial
contact, surgery and post-op follow-ups. Every step of your experience at Seibel Vision Surgery is
designed to ensure your best possible visual outcome. Industry Recognition: Esteemed as an expert
consultant and surgeon, Dr. Seibel is highly sought after by ophthalmic companies to help assist in
the development of new surgical platforms. Custom-Tailored Cataract Surgery: Dr. Seibel provides
this for each eye of each patient, based on the principles in his acclaimed textbook, Phacodynamics,
resulting in the gentlest and most effective surgery during every moment of the procedure.

## Cataract Surgery with Dr. Seibel

Cataract surgery technology has experienced incredible advancements in the last several years. With
the introduction of these new materials and advanced technology, cataract surgery has been pushed
past a purely medical procedure to become a refractive or vision-correcting procedure.

The benefits of modern cataract surgery are many. It affords an almost miraculous restoration of
clear vision. It is one of the few medical procedures that can literally turn back the hands of
time, for many patients achieve vision comparable to the eyesight they enjoyed in their youth.

At Seibel Vision Surgery, Dr. Seibel is proud to offer safe and effective cataract surgery using
advanced technology to restore your vision!

Barry S. Seibel, MD, widely regarded as one of the best cataract surgeons in Los Angeles, is

Cataract surgery technology has experienced incredible advancements in the last several years. With
the introduction of these new materials and advanced technology, cataract surgery has been pushed
past a purely medical procedure to become a refractive or vision-correcting procedure.

clear vision. It is one of the few medical procedures that can literally turn back the hands of

## Vision Center - See and Be Seen

At Vision Center, we know that eyes are the window to the world - they shape how you experience
life's beauty and connect with loved ones. Clear vision fosters wonder and brings joy into focus,
making moments more colorful, vivid, and memorable. Good sight literally brightens life's views,
while vision challenges can dim the details.

That’s why we exist - to guide and empower people to truly see and be seen.

Our team of eye doctors, optometrists, and patient advocates deeply understand the challenges of
navigating vision care. We research, create, and curate practical vision health resources you can
trust.

Vision Center offers reliable guidance to answer your questions around eye conditions, finding
eyewear, connecting with eye doctors, and considering vision correction options if needed. We aim to
bring life’s most meaningful moments into sharper focus.

## Vision Center - See and Be Seen

At Vision Center, we know that eyes are the window to the world - they shape how you experience
life's beauty and connect with loved ones. Clear vision fosters wonder and brings joy into focus,
making moments more colorful, vivid, and memorable. Good sight literally brightens life's views,
while vision challenges can dim the details.

That’s why we exist - to guide and empower people to truly see and be seen.

Our team of eye doctors, optometrists, and patient advocates deeply understand the challenges of
navigating vision care. We research, create, and curate practical vision health resources you can
trust.

Vision Center offers reliable guidance to answer your questions around eye conditions, finding
eyewear, connecting with eye doctors, and considering vision correction options if needed. We aim to
bring life’s most meaningful moments into sharper focus.
